name: Calcium HMB
whatItIs: A calcium salt of beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate, a leucine metabolite.
howItWorks: HMB is studied in relation to muscle-protein breakdown and adaptation, especially under demanding training conditions.
whyIncluded: Muscle-preservation and recovery positioning in strength formulas.

evidenceSupportedRanges.context: Common daily amount discussed in the ISSN position stand.

evidenceLimitations: Finished-product effects cannot be inferred from one ingredient in isolation.
Research outcomes vary by training status, protocol, and total daily use.
possibleSideEffects: No product-specific side-effect statement is stored; consult the current label warnings.
